integrity: Theorem established by a finite-dimensional analytic argument. Exact rational example independently checkable with embedded standard-library program. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Scalar globally C3 strictly convex entropy on the real line; fixed weighted mean, one entropy budget and strictly positive quadrature weights. The theorem does not cover invariant-domain intersections, multiple entropy constraints, physical-domain restrictions or PDE convergence. Historical priority is limited to inspected primary material; one radial-separability paper was only accessible as an abstract.
title: Sharp two-node boundary for least-squares optimality of radial entropy limiting
